\subsubsection*{Adopted relations}

\paragraph{effective\_temperature}
definition (equation). Convert the gas profile to the pressure-equivalent wind profile.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
T_{\rm eff}(r)=T(r)/\mu(r)
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.mathematical_5f_model_3a_composition_5f_wind:effective_5f_temperature:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} effective\_temperature (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} Sample values before Hermite interpolation; no thermochemical solution is implied.

\begin{description}
\item[$T$] T $\mapsto$ temperature. Gas kinetic temperature, not the pressure-equivalent solver profile.
\item[$T_{\rm eff}$] T\_eff $\mapsto$ effective\_temperature. Pressure-equivalent temperature T/mu passed to the wind solver with mu=1.
\item[$\mu$] mu $\mapsto$ mu. Mean particle mass including free electrons, in proton-mass units.
\item[$r$] r $\mapsto$ radius. Distance from the planet centre at atmosphere cell centres.
\end{description}

\noindent\textbf{Assumptions:}
\begin{itemize}
\item Interpolate log(T/mu) in log radius with the documented zero endpoint slopes and constant extension.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{pressure\_ratio}
definition (equation). Ideal-gas pressure ratio retains the composition gradient through T/mu.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
a^2(r)=k_B T_{\rm eff}(r)/m_H
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.mathematical_5f_model_3a_composition_5f_wind:pressure_5f_ratio:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} pressure\_ratio (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} The effective solver uses mu=1; gamma does not multiply this pressure ratio.

\begin{description}
\item[$T_{\rm eff}$] T\_eff $\mapsto$ effective\_temperature. Pressure-equivalent temperature T/mu passed to the wind solver with mu=1.
\item[$a^2$] a2 $\mapsto$ sound\_squared. Isothermal pressure ratio P/rho, not the adiabatic sound speed squared.
\item[$k_B$] kB $\mapsto$ boltzmann. Boltzmann constant in cgs.
\item[$m_H$] mH $\mapsto$ proton\_mass. Proton mass used by the pressure relation.
\item[$r$] r $\mapsto$ radius. Distance from the planet centre at atmosphere cell centres.
\end{description}

\paragraph{wind\_momentum}
momentum (equation). Steady nonisothermal radial momentum with linear effective tidal gravity.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
\left(v-\frac{a^2}{v}\right)\frac{dv}{dr}=\frac{2a^2}{r}-\frac{da^2}{dr}-\frac{GM_p}{r^2}+\kappa r
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.mathematical_5f_model_3a_composition_5f_wind:wind_5f_momentum:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} wind\_momentum (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} A prescribed positive smooth pressure profile and a single regular wind critical point.

\begin{description}
\item[$GM_p$] GMp $\mapsto$ planet\_gm. Planetary gravitational parameter.
\item[$a^2$] a2 $\mapsto$ sound\_squared. Isothermal pressure ratio P/rho, not the adiabatic sound speed squared.
\item[$\kappa$] kappa $\mapsto$ tidal\_coefficient. Nonnegative linear star-planet-axis tidal coefficient.
\item[$r$] r $\mapsto$ radius. Distance from the planet centre at atmosphere cell centres.
\item[$v$] v $\mapsto$ velocity. Outward radial wind speed in cgs; Python wind output is in km/s.
\end{description}

\noindent\textbf{Assumptions:}
\begin{itemize}
\item The linear tide is used with spherical mass conservation; this is not full Roche geometry.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{wind\_critical}
regularity\_condition (constraint). Select a regular transonic point.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
v(r_c)^2=a^2(r_c),\qquad \frac{2a^2(r_c)}{r_c}-\left.\frac{da^2}{dr}\right|_{r_c}-\frac{GM_p}{r_c^2}+\kappa r_c=0
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.mathematical_5f_model_3a_composition_5f_wind:wind_5f_critical:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} wind\_critical (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} The wind branch and domain guards are additional declared solver choices, not a proof of global uniqueness.

\begin{description}
\item[$GM_p$] GMp $\mapsto$ planet\_gm. Planetary gravitational parameter.
\item[$a^2$] a2 $\mapsto$ sound\_squared. Isothermal pressure ratio P/rho, not the adiabatic sound speed squared.
\item[$\kappa$] kappa $\mapsto$ tidal\_coefficient. Nonnegative linear star-planet-axis tidal coefficient.
\item[$r$] r $\mapsto$ radius. Distance from the planet centre at atmosphere cell centres.
\item[$r_c$] r\_c $\mapsto$ critical\_radius. The selected regular transonic critical radius within the wind domain.
\item[$v$] v $\mapsto$ velocity. Outward radial wind speed in cgs; Python wind output is in km/s.
\end{description}

\paragraph{mass\_continuity}
conservation (equation). Convert steady spherical mass flux and wind speed to total mass density.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
\rho(r)=\frac{\dot M}{4\pi r^2v(r)}
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.mathematical_5f_model_3a_composition_5f_wind:mass_5f_continuity:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} mass\_continuity (revision 1).

\item[$v$] v $\mapsto$ velocity. Outward radial wind speed in cgs; Python wind output is in km/s.
